title: App Theme vs Terminal Theme: the window chrome (sidebar, tab strips, titlebar) takes the App Theme; terminals keep the Terminal Theme; Settings says what each row colors

steps.title: Terminal Theme Soft Blue, App Theme Match Terminal Theme
App Theme set to Soft Blue Light: the sidebar, tabs and titlebar should turn light; the terminal stays Soft Blue
Settings > Theme: what each row colors
steps.optional: Settings may open on another section
